query:
UPDATE crm_connections
         SET status = 'DISCONNECTED',
             disconnected_at = now(),
             last_error_code = $4,
             last_error_message = $5,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE organization_id = $1
           AND id = $2
           AND provider = 'SALESFORCE'
           AND status = 'CONNECTED'
           AND access_token = $3
         RETURNING
            id,
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            provider::text AS "provider!",
            status::text AS "status!",
            connected_at,
            disconnected_at,
            last_error_code,
            last_error_message
